duration: One Zoom meeting a month (Sunday, 7 pm) and 1 to 2 in-person meetings a year
name: Illinois 4-H Food Advocacy Ambassadors
what_you_do: A statewide teen team that works on food access. Members meet with food experts, plan projects, and may speak to community groups or elected officials.
who_can_apply: Teens who are 13 or older, enrolled in or past their first year of high school, with some community service. Needs a reference from an Extension staff member, school staff member or youth worker.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Illinois 4-H Ambassador Application (link on the page) and get a reference. Questions: Mark Becker, mbbecker@illinois.edu.
notes: Cost to attend in-person meetings is not stated.
